_comment: Example ~/cicy-ai/db/lite-config.json (todo #103). Absent file = built-in defaults (current behavior). Entries below MERGE over defaults per map key, so you only declare what you add/override. Hot-read each turn; activation of the engine itself needs the new binary + one restart.

profiles._doc: Override or add profiles. systemBase: @dispatcher|@assistant|@liaison (Go consts) | @role:<slug> (a role template body) | literal text. external=true hard-caps the profile (grants ignored, custom tools refused).

electron_windows.description: 列出 cicy-desktop 的 Electron 窗口(JSON)

desktop_screenshot.description: 对 cicy-desktop 截图(返回保存路径)

chrome_eval.description: 在指定 Chrome profile 页面里执行 JS 断言 DOM(只填参数,命令固定)

grants._doc: Grant custom tool groups precisely. by_agent overrides per pane id; by_profile per profile. External profiles ignore all grants.
